_comment: Firewall Or Security Agent Disabled. Generated from rules/disable_security_tools.yml by tools/build.py; do not edit.

properties.description: The session flushes iptables, disables ufw or SELinux, or stops firewalld, AppArmor or a cloud provider's security agent (Alibaba Cloud's aegis / aliyun-service), clearing the way for the payload and its outbound connections.
